The lysate was diluted at a ratio of 1:10 with dilution buffer containing LysC/trypsin (1:10, enzyme: protein), followed by overnight digestion at 37 °C.
Proteins from LCM blocks were extracted with 5 µL lysis buffer (6 M guanidinium chloride, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 20 mM iodoacetamide, 100 mM Tris, pH 8.5) at 95 °C for 60 min.
